name: ui_select
description: Query detailed properties of a UI element by selector. Returns the element's full attribute set: text, resource-id, content-desc, bounds, center, class, clickable/enabled/checked/focused/scrollable states. The read counterpart to ui_tap.

content_desc.description: Content-description (accessibility label) of the element to query. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

coords.description: Direct [x, y] coordinates to query the element at that position

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)

exact.description: Match id/text/content_desc by full-string equality (case-insensitive) instead of the default substring match.

id.description: Resource ID of the element to query. Case-insensitive substring of the simple id (text after ':id/') by default, e.g. 'search_input' matches 'com.android.app:id/search_input'. Set exact=true for full-id equality.

text.description: Visible text of the element to query. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

arguments.description: Generated MCP request struct for this tool.
arguments.title: UiSelectRequest
